lines: What this next song is about is what's inside my head
The star, of course, is you
I'm the supporting actor, the director, and the cameraman
It's a story of a film made from the reel deep behind my eyes Ah
If you laughed and called it silly, well, that's a great opening—everything's fine!
Don't write it off just yet, hold on a second
I think you'll come to like it
Let me show you just a little of the highlights so far
The tears on the night of our first fight
It hurts my heart to watch, personally
But let's keep watching, just as it is
You say you're sorry, we make up, we hold hands…
See, this is where you smile—that's the best scene of all Ah
In that tiny gesture no photograph could ever capture
There are moments overflowing that could overturn any dark storyline
Let me cut out one of them
And make it the thumbnail, for now at least
Ten years from now, the cast will probably have grown
I can barely keep up already, and on this meager pay it's way over capacity!
I'm sure I'll show you plenty of pathetic moments too
The day we shared one family name
The days when nothing changed at all
Days so dear, days so precious
I'll burn them in, so I don't miss them, so I don't forget
Now, us—eyes softening, cheeks flushing, wishing for eternity
When misunderstandings and gloomy plot twists tried to tear us apart
I'll sing this song, loud enough to be a nuisance, over and over
So please, stay by my side
Because I don't even want to make an end roll
When we wrap, we can't decide
So let's go where the wind blows us
The film is ready
Long enough for a lifetime—roughly 1.15 million kilometers
See, this is where you smile—that's the best scene of all Ah
In that tiny gesture no photograph could ever capture
There are moments overflowing that could overturn any dark storyline
Let me cut out one of them
And make it the thumbnail
Come on, let's go searching for the great scenes yet to be born
The bitter and the sweet, side by side
Let's taste them together until the film runs out
Let's keep shooting as long as this life lasts
